Hello all,
just to support as quick as possible from Volvo Trucks. Please see here my dashboard some seconds ago.
I received an interruption at 9:22 and it says, “Emergency shutdown of the EVSE”. All other attempts were successful “completed” and were terminated es expected (at least on the part of the truck).
The status “completed” is set if the charging process has been terminated and the trigger was a request for termination from the charger or user. Since the user is asking for support, I guess he didn’t want to terminate the session…
@Siemens – Could you please doublecheck the sequence BEFORE the “
ERR_EV_xxx
” was set? Is there any hint on WHY the vehicle set this fault?
Thank you for your cooperation!
BR Arthur

PilotState dropped from C to B

Thank you very much for your patience so far.

Francisco
